- Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, database schema normalization, indexing, query optimization, audit-trail architecture
- Security & Auth: Multi-tenant tenant isolation (`tenant_id`/`school_id`), Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), JWT authentication, session tokens
- Async & Queues: Redis patterns, BullMQ background job queues, async PDF/report generation
- Payment Systems: Safaricom M-Pesa Daraja API integration (STK Push / C2B / Lipa na M-Pesa), Paystack webhook automation
